full_judgment:
12. Jahangir Kabir Bhuiyan informant of the case, as PW-I in his examination-in-chief stated that on the basis of secret information, they came to know that one Reaz Mahmud was trading illegal arms, Accordingly they entered into an agreement with convict Reaz to purchase arms at the cost of Tk.80,000/- Then a team came under the leadership of Major Abul Kalam Samsuddin from Chittagong. Major Kalam booked room No.12 of the Moynamoti Residential Hotel, Comilla for the place of trading arms. Therefore, accused Reaz Mahmud along with accused Ripon, Mosharaf, Mahbub and Hasan came to room No. 12. Then, they apprehended all of them and searched their body in front of Hotel Manager Selim, employee Humayun & Badal. After search, they recovered l(one) 32 bore revolver about 9 inch long made in USA from the waist of the accused Reaz Mahtnud, two round 'bullets of .32 bore revolver from the waist of the accused Ripon, 1(one) 303 Riffle (কাটা রাইফেল), about 18 1/2 inch long with magazine volt wrapping by old paper from accused Mosharaf and 4(four) round bullets of Rifle from the right pocket of the trouser of the accused Mahbub. Sub Inspector Mizanur Rahman prepared the seizure list on the spot. Thereafter he along with convict appellants went to police station and lodged this FIR. He proved the FIR and his signature therein as exhibit-I and I/I. He also produced all arms and ammunition before the court and proved those as material Exhibit No. I, II, III, IV and V series. He identified the accused persons in the dock except Ripon. 

 13. Pw-2 Major Abul Kalam Shamsuddin in his examination in chief stated that on 24.4.2007 he along with his force came 'Feni Camp' from Chittagong. At about 2 am at night they started from Feni to Comilla and reached Moynamoti Hotel at about 5:25 am. Then Reaz came to him for trading arms. After discussion Reaz went out and thereafter came back at about 9 am along with 4 persons and show their arms. At that moment he along, with his forces, disclosed their identify and apprehended all the accused persons. They recovered pistol from the waist of the accused Reaz, 2 round bullets from inner side of the lungi of accused Ripon, one 303 Rifle from accused Mosharaf, 4 round bullets from accused Mahbub and an Air Gun from accused Hasan. Then as per his direction ASI Mizan prepared the seizure list; and Inspector Zahangir lodged the FIR In cross he stated that he did not inform SP Comilla or any law' enforcing authority 'like CID, NSI, DGFI about the recovery of arms also. He could not remember which name he rented the room No.12 He also stated that “আসামীদেরকে কখন search করে এখন মনে নাই। কে অস্ত্র উদ্ধার করে এখন মনে নাই। He lastly stated in his cross that in the GD No. 265, he did not 4 mention any recovery of arms. 

 14. Md. Delwar Hossain as PW-3 in his examination-in-chief stated that approximately at about 5 a.m. he went to Moynamoti residential hotel and staying room No.7 along with ASI Mizanur Rahman. At about 9 a.m. they went to room No. 12 and caught all the convict appellants with arms in front of the hotel manager and employees. 

 15. Noor Mohammad ASI, S.B. as PW-4 in his examination-in-chief stated that at about 9:00-9:30 he went to the mom No.I2 and saw the convict appellants with arms. 

 17. Md. Asaduzzaman Taposh, Captain, RAB-7, Chittagong as PW-6 in his examination-in-chief stated that on 25.4.2007 at about 2:00 p.m. at night on the basis of secret information he started from Feni to Comilla and at about 5:00 a.m. reached Moynamoti Residential Hotel. And at about 9:30 on call from his senior officer, he went to the room No-12 and saw the hotel manager Salim, employees of the hotel, his senior officer Captain Nazmul, DAD Jahangir, ASI Delwar, ASI-Mizan along with accused Reaz, Hasan, Mosharaf, Mahbub and Ripon with arms. 

 18. Akkas All ASI, RAB-7, Chittagong as PW-7 in his examination-in-chief stated that at about 9:15 p.m. when 4/5 accused persons came to the mom No. 12 then they disclosed their identity as RAB and they pushed the accused persons into the room. 

 19. Borhan Uddin Constable, RAB -7 Chittagong as PW-8 in his examination-in-chief stated that at about 9:35/40 he along with captain Taposh went to the room No. 12 of the Hotel Moynamoti and saw the convict appellants, hotel manager along with 2/3 persons. 

 20. Salim Ahmed manager of the Hotel Moynamoti, Comilla as, PW 9 in his examination-in-chief stated that on 25.04.2007 at about -5:30-6 am. RAB brought 5 persons and were confined to Hotel room under lock and key. 

 This witness declared hostile by the prosecution side. He was cross examined by the prosecution at length but he reiterated his chief. In cross he stated that “ঘটনার দিন ৪ জন সহ মোট ৫ জনকে র‌্যাব Handcuff দিয়ে হোটেলে নিয়ে আসে। আমি তখন আসামীদের হাতে অস্ত্র দেখি নাই।” 

 21. Badol an employee of the hotel as PW-10 in his examination-in-chief stated that as per direction of RAB personnel he had signed the seizure list however did not see any arms. This witness also declared hostile by the prosecution side. He was cross examined by the prosecution at length. In his cross ho stated that “২৫/০৪/০৭ তারিখ ঘটনা। ঐ দিন সকালে ৯টা/৮.৪৫ মিঃ আমি হোটেলে আসি। এসে শুনি ৫জনকে ধরে ১২নং কক্ষে র‌্যাব রেখেছে। আমি গিয়ে দেখি ১২নং রুম তালা মারা। জানালা দিয়ে ৫জন আসামীকে ঘরে দেখি।” 

 23. Ataul Gani Executive Magistrate as PW-12 in his examination-in-chief stated that on 08.05.2002; Gazi Md. Ibrahim Khalil, SI, Kotwali Police Station produced witnesses Selim Ahmed, Humayun Kabir and Badal before him and accordingly he took statements of the aforesaid witnesses under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. He proved the statements as Exhibit 3, 3/1, 4, 4/2 and 5, 5/1. In cross he stated that “সরকারী Form না থাকায় Prescribe Form এ আমি স্বাক্ষীর জবানবন্দী রেকর্ড করি।” 

 24. Md. Nazmul Alam Captain, RAB-7 Chittagong as Pw-13 in his examination-in-chief stated that at about 7/7:30 a.m. accused Reaz met with him and entered into an agreement that he will sale 2 (two) arms at the cost of Tk. 80,000/-. Thereafter at about 9/9:30 accused Reaz came along with other accused’s and arms and ammunition. Then, he along with Major Shamsuddin, ASI Mizan, DAD Delwar and Zahangir disclosed their identity as RAB and apprehended the accused with their arms and ammunition. At that moment 4 (four) employees of the Hotel were present there. 

 25. Md. Mostafizur Rahman, RAB-7 Chittagong as Pw-14 in his examination-in-chief stated that on 25.04.2007 he was driving the RAB CAR along with captain Asad and others and reached to Moynamoti Residential Hotel at about 5 am. He was standing a side of his car. Major Shamsuddin with some others went to Room No.12 of the hotel. Thereafter, he went to the room No. 12 and saw all the accused persons apprehended with arms. 

 26. Md. Mizanur Rahman, AS.I., RAB-7 Feni as Pw-15 in his examination-in-chief that on 25.04.2007 he was staying in the room No.7 of the Moynamoti Hotel. When all the accused persons came to the room No.12 immediately he along with DAD Zahangir S.I. Delwar entered into the room No. 12. At that moment hotel manager Selim employee Badol and Humayun were also with them. Captain Nazmul searched the accused persons and recovered one revolver from the waist of the accused Reaz, 2 rounds of bullets of the revolver from accused Ripon, one 303 rifle wrapping with old paper from the right hand of Mosharaf 4 rounds cartridges of the rifle from accused Mahbub and one Banduk wrapping with old paper from accused Hasan. According to instruction he made the seizure list, he proved the seizure list and his signature there in as exhibit-2, 2/3. 

 27. Gazi Md. Ibrahim, Police Inspector, as Pw-16 in his examination-in-chief staled that he is the 1.0. of this case and he scrutinized the FIR of the informant and seizure list. He visited the place of occurrence, prepared the sketch map with index and also took statements under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. He also produced 3 seizure list witnesses namely Salim, Badol and Humayun before the Magistrate for taking statements under section 164 of the Code of Criminal1Procedure. He also seized the registry book of the Moynamoti Residential Hotel and Tk. 80,000/- and accordingly submitted charge sheet. He proved the sketch map and index and signature there in as exhibit-6, 6/1, 7, 7/1 he also proved the jimmanama as exhibit-8, 8/1 and also handed over to the money of the informant by jimmanama and he proved the jimmanama as exhibit-9, 9/1. 

 28. Md. Khalilur Rahman, Security Habilder of Chapapur Bakhrabad Gas System Ltd., Comilla, as DW-1 in his examination in chief stated that he was working over there last 4 years. On 24.04.07 he was on duty from 10 pm at night to 6 am in front of the Gate No. 5 of the Staff Quarter. At about 10:05 p.m. five people came and took his permission to visit Mafizur Rahman. At that time one Delwar signed in the guest registry book on behalf of other. Thereafter, they came out from the house of Mafiz with his son Mosharaf at about 12:05 minutes and took away him by a microbus. He wrote all this occurrences in the Registry Book. He showed the photocopy of the Registrar where name of Delwar was written as serial No.26. 

 In cross he reiterated his statement of examination in chief. 

 35. Apart from, PW-1, PW-2, PW-7, PW-13 and PW-15 (member of the trap party) as prosecution witnesses given contradictory and suspicion statement in respect of apprehension of the convict appellants and recovery of alleged arms and ammunition from them. PW-1 (Jahangir) stated that,  অস্ত্র গুলি আমার সামনে উদ্ধার করা হয় ৷ কার নিকট কি অস্ত্র পাওয়া যায় জব্দ তালিকায় নেই । আসামীদের আমাদের লোক সার্চ করে ৷ পরে বলে ৩/৪ জন জন আসামীদের সার্চ করে ৷ ঐ দিন আমরা ১২ নং কক্ষটিতে মেজর সামসুদ্দিন ছিল। আমরা হোটেলের বাহিরে ছিলাম ৷ আসামীরা সকাল ৯ টায় ৫ জন হোটেলে আসে ৷ রুমের ভিতর আমাদের force দেলোয়ার, মিজান , আককাস, জাহাঙ্গীর হামিদুল সহ ১০/১১ জন প্রবেশ করে ৷ PW-2 (Shamsuddin) stated that ১২ নং রুমে আমি সহ ক্যাপ্টেন নাজমুল ছিল ৷ সকলে ৭.৩০ মিনিট পর্যন্ত আমি সহ নাজমুল ঐ রুমে ছিলাম৷ এ সময় মোট ৭ জন আমার রুমে ছিল ৷ কে অস্ত্র উদ্ধার করে তখন মনে নাই ।আসামীদের কে প্রথম search করে মনে নাই৷ আমি ২৬৫ নং জিডি,তে অস্ত্র উদ্ধারের কথা বলিনি৷ PW-7(Akkas)stated that in Chief that আমি ৮ নং রুমে অবস্থান নেই ৷ সকলে অনুমান ৯.১৫ মিনিটে ৪/৫ জন লোক হোটেলের ১২ নং রুমের সামনে আসে ৷ ঐ রুমে মেজর সামসুদ্দিন ও ক্যাপ্টেন নাজমুল আগে থেকে বসা ছিল ৷ নাজমুল আসামীদের তল্লাশি করে ৷ PW-13 (Nazmul) In cross stated that-আমি থানায় যাইনি ৷ আমাদের অভিযানে মোট কতজন সদস্য ছিল মনে নাই ৷ কাকে ১ম search করি তখন মনে নাই৷ PW-15 Md. Mizanur Rahman, in chief আমি ৭ নং কক্ষে ছিলাম৷ He prepared the seizure list and he proved the seizure list as Ex-l, 2, 2/3. In cross he stated that কোন আসামীর হেফাজত থেকে কি আলামত উদ্ধার হয় নির্দিষ্টভাবে জব্দ তালিকায় তা বলা নাই৷ এজাহার দায়ের করে সন্ধ্যরে পর থানায় চলে আসি৷
